summary: Ergo is a self-hosted IRC server (Go) that persists registered accounts, registered channels, channel purge records, and D/K-lines in a buntdb KV datastore, plus an optional SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL backend storing per-channel and per-account message history. The IRC protocol commands and an operator web API form the op surface.

_no_edges.why: login authenticates and sets session state; triggers no further persisted ops; guarded by credential check in auth effect (nickserv.go:831)
in-memory client membership change; for always-on clients, persistence is implicit via markDirty; triggers no downstream op (channelmanager.go:105)
removes client from in-memory membership and records Part history; no downstream DB op (channel.go:1038)
pure message relay with optional history write as side effect; the history write is not a separate reachable op (handlers.go:2476)
adds per-client invite exemption in memory; no downstream op (handlers.go:1429)
internal persistence callback from message relay; no route, no auth, no downstream op (channel.go:743)
internal persistence callback from DM relay; no route, no auth, no downstream op (client.go:1778)
reloads config from disk; no DB writes, no downstream op (server.go:683)
sets in-memory defcon level; no DB writes, no downstream op (api.go:133)
in-memory membership removal and history recording; no downstream op (channel.go:1542)
rewrites channel name in memory and reindexes; no downstream op (channelmanager.go:280)
deletes a channel purge record by UUID; no triggers, the deletion is the op (channelmanager.go:439)
oper gated standalone dline write with no downstream triggers (Server.go)
oper gated standalone undline write with no downstream triggers (Server.go)
